answer: Calibration labs show how to price out a fake agent. An accreditation body binds each ISO 17025 certificate number to one scope, one approved signatory and one reference standard whose serial is logged per calibration, and a second lab quoting that number is refused at intake. A duplicate certificate trips suspension, voids every report and calls the indemnity policy. A standard runs 2400, an assessor day 500 and the filing 200, so N clones burn N x 3100 and each needs a real signatory. A mirror on the wall, a walnut case for the weights and a ferrous stand do not make the serial new.
